name: oauth-setup
actions: (() => { const s=document.querySelector('#scopes'); if(!s) return 'no-scopes'; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email'); ['input','change','keyup','blur'].forEach(t=>s.dispatchEvent(new Event(t,{bubbles:true}))); return s.value; })()
